diagram_previews.alt: A circle through A, B, C, D; the blue equilateral triangle PAB (side a) and the orange equilateral triangle PCD (side b) meet only at P, pointing in opposite directions; A, P, D and B, P, C are collinear, and the red chord BD is drawn. The centre O lies near P.

A unit circle with centre O; from P = (-sqrt 3, 0) the large equilateral triangle PAB (A and B on the circle at (0, 1) and (0, -1)) contains the small equilateral triangle PCD, whose other vertices also lie on the circle.
